pooled.scope: All 168 held-out predictions; per-point cubic-baseline predictions were not present in the frozen input

limitations: The full-data NIST certified-fit reproduction checks implementation only and is not holdout evidence
Native and rational fold-level RMSE comparisons are descriptive and do not establish a universal model ranking
No rational denominator, ellipsoid, box or continuous-safety claim is transferred to the native Fourier model
Period variation across folds is descriptive and is not a posterior distribution or proof of new physical cycles
This is a reanalysis of public observations, not a new independent physical experiment or validation of physical endogeneity
Optimizer failures, non-finite predictions and fold-level losses are retained rather than hidden
